_comment: Single source of truth for modes. Read by main (prompt building, native mode menu) and the renderer (labels, dropdown). kind: standalone = main/prompts/<key>.txt; builder = handled by a renderer builder flow, transcript passed through unchanged. profile: voice = uses the user's "How you write" notes; about = uses their "About you" notes. dictation = no Claude call: the transcript itself, tidied (main/dictation.js) and typed into the app you are in. destination = told which app the result is going to. promptStyle = offered for "Make it a prompt". aliases = retired mode keys (history entries, saved settings, spoken names) and the mode that replaced them.
